items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Yeah. Peter Bocasch. Hippolyte Shawls. Oh, yeah. I remember them.

ctx.x: Why did you call him that? That's a funny nickname.

Well, that's all we had knew. I knew him, boy. He was an old man. He was strict. Very strict. And he was the leader of the band. I knew that. Remember any other trumpets? I don't know. I couldn't remember. Any of the trombone players? Yeah, I know. Buddy Johnson was one of the trombones. Buddy Johnson was one of the trombones. I believe Peter Bocasch. They played trumpet. Yeah. Peter Bocasch. Hippolyte Shawls. Oh, yeah. I remember them. And old man Giles. You know what I'm talking about? Giles. Albert Giles. He…
Is that Clay Giles? The man they call Clay?
